about:
The Operator Economy shows experienced professionals how to build, own and operate a business of one using AI.

Each episode takes one business you could run yourself: what it sells, who pays for it, what it can honestly charge, and where it breaks. Then it walks through how to start it. Sourced numbers, stated limits, no income promises.

Every episode comes with a free Operator Canvas, the working document behind the video.

New episodes Mondays.

Episodes are presented by an AI avatar of the host, with narration in a clone of his voice. The research and the arguments are his.
